on/hamilton.lead: The City of Hamilton includes the former towns and townships of Ancaster, Dundas, Flamborough, Glanbrook and Stoney Creek, joined in 2001.
on/hamilton.source: City of Hamilton, about the city

on/greater-sudbury.lead: The City of Greater Sudbury was formed in 2001 from the former City of Sudbury, the regional municipality and the surrounding towns and townships.
